"''We're starting our approach.|Jad Bean and Captain Yorr as Yorr and Jendon begin their approach|audio=Bean-Yorr-ROTJ.flac|}} '''Jendon''' was a [[colonel]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy]] who co-[[pilot]]ed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|shuttle]], ''[[ST 321]]'', with [[Captain]] [[Yorr]]. In [[4 ABY]], they [[transport]]ed Vader from the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Avenger]]'' to the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] while in the [[Endor system]]. During the [[Battle of Endor]], Jendon then [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|piloted]] a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], although the Empire was ultimately defeated and the [[Death Star]] destroyed. ==Biography== ===Captain's co-pilot=== {{Quote|Command station, this is ST-321, code clearance blue. We are starting our approach. Deactivate the security shield.''"
"''The security deflector shield will be deactivated when we have confirmation of your code transmission. Stand by.|Captain Yorr and Jad Bean|audio=Yorr-Bean-ROTJ.flac|}} [[File:ST-321-Viewport-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Jendon (right) and Yorr piloted the shuttle ''ST 321'' while transporting Darth Vader to the second Death Star in the Endor system.]] Jendon was a [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] and held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[colonel]] in the [[Imperial Navy]]'s [[Imperial Navy's officer corps|officer corps]] while working as co-[[pilot]] of ''[[ST 321]]'', the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. In [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]]. Jendon piloted the [[shuttle]] alongside [[Captain]] [[Yorr]] when it departed from the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Avenger]]'s''{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the Empire and the Rebellion}} [[hangar]] while the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] was in the [[Endor system]] near the construction site of the incomplete [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] in [[orbit]] over the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. Escorted by two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s that also exited the hangar, Jendon and Yorr flew ''ST 321'' toward the [[Death Star]] in order to [[transport]] Vader there. During the journey, Yorr informed the Death Star of the shuttle's approach over [[Comm unit|comms]] and asked [[flight controller]]''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' [[Jad Bean]]''[[TIE Fighter Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' to deactivate the [[battle station]]'s [[Deflector shield|shields]]. Once Bean had received the [[Starship|shuttle's]] transmission codes, he temporarily deactivated a section of the shields and cleared them to land, allowing Yorr and Jendon to pilot the shuttle into one of the Death Star's hangars as their [[TIE series|TIE]] escort departed. On board the Death Star, Vader exited the shuttle and met with [[Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod]] in the hangar to discuss the station's construction. ===Death Star defender=== {{Quote|Fighters coming in!|[[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] spots the Imperial starfighters at the Battle of Endor|audio=Lando-Fighters-ROTJ.flac|}} [[File:ColonelJendon-SWZ99.png|thumb|right|250px|Jendon piloted a TIE Defender during the Battle of Endor.]] Vader was soon joined on the Death Star by [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who put a plan into action to lure the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] into attacking the Death Star so that he could end the [[Galactic Civil War]] by destroying them with the [[Space station|station's]] fully functional [[superlaser]]. With Palpatine's presence and the station's incomplete status as bait, the Alliance fell for the trap and launched an [[Battle of Endor|assault]]. As soon as its [[fleet]] arrived in the Endor [[Star system|system]], the rebels were surrounded by [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] and engaged in combat. Jendon was amongst those who flew against them, [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|piloting]] a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]] as part of the [[Imperial Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] near the Death Star. Palpatine ordered that only the Empire's starfighters engage the rebel fleet and had the Imperial [[capital ship]]s hold their fire, as he wished to send a message by having the Death Star's superlaser pick off the Alliance's major vessels. Ultimately, [[Endor strike team|rebel forces]] on the moon succeeded in deactivating the Death Star's [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]], which allowed the rebel fleet to destroy the Death Star and defeat the remaining Imperials present. ==Personality and traits== Jendon had light skin and [[Color|graying]] [[hair]]. ==Equipment== Jendon wore a black [[Imperial officer's uniform]] that included an [[Imperial kepi]] with an [[officer's disk]] while piloting ''ST 321''. During the Battle of Endor, the colonel flew a new variant of the TIE/d "Defender" armed with [[proton cannon]]s. The vessel was also equipped with [[computer]]-assisted handling and incorporated secret [[Chiss]] engineering. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:HavordInANH.png|thumb|right|300px|Mike Havord portrayed Jendon and Chiraneau in ''Return of the Jedi'' and an Imperial Officer (pictured) in ''A New Hope''.]] Jendon appeared in the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which was released on [[March 25]], [[1983]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]'' [[Mike Havord]] portrayed the character{{WebCite|url=https://celebrityinkautographs.co.uk/products/mike-havord-as-colonel-jendon-star-wars|text=MIKE HAVORD as Colonel Jendon - Star Wars|work=[http://celebrityinkautographs.co.uk Celebrity Ink Autographs]|archivedate=20240712103611}} uncredited and also appeared as{{WebCite|url=https://bid.eastbristol.co.uk/past-auctions/sreas10560/lot-details/8657729d-8fb5-4d99-b26a-ae2a01070019|text=Star Wars - Imperial Officers - Autograph Collection|work=[https://eastbristol.co.uk/ East Bristol Auctions]|archivedate=20240814145604}} [[Admiral]] [[Chiraneau]]{{FFGXW2|set=Galactic Empire Conversion Kit|cardname=Rear Admiral Chiraneau}} in the film. According to[[:File:MikeHavord-KennethCoombsFacebook.png|Facebook message]] from [[Kenneth Coombs]] — Used with permission actor{{SW|url=news/star-wars-in-the-uk-memorabilia-23-24-november-2013|text=Star Wars in the UK: Memorabilia, 23-24 November 2013}} [[Kenneth Coombs]], Havord had also portrayed an Imperial officer in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], although this character has not been identified as Jendon, Chiraneau, or a separate individual. The shuttle cockpit scenes were filmed on Stage 6 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[March 24]] and [[March 31]], [[1982]].''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]'' According to actor [[Jasper Jacob]],{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2012/03/archive-blog-star-wars-stars-at.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=Jasper Jacob - Captain Yorr - Shuttle Pilot - ROTJ}} who portrayed Yorr,{{WebCite|url=https://www.showmasterssales.com/products/copy-of-jasper-jacobs-10x8-signed-in-silver-with-character-name-return-of-the-jedi|text=Jasper Jacob 10X8 Signed in Silver with Character Name Return of the Jedi|work=[http://showmasterssales.com Showmasters Comic Con Official Autograph Shop]|archivedate=20211023152458}} the pair's scene took two days of filming with director [[Richard Marquand]] directing both days. In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Jendon's name was first used in a preview for the ''[[Battle Over Endor Scenario Pack]]'' set for [[Atomic Mass Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]'' board game posted on [[February 5]], [[2024]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Jendon/Legends|Jendon]] was first identified in [[2000]] on cards in the "[[Death Star II Limited]]" set for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] published by [[Decipher]]{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Captain Yorr}}{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Colonel Jendon}}{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Onyx 1}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Jendon}} *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/star-wars-x-wing-battle-over-endor-imperial-preview|text=Star Wars: X-Wing — Battle Over Endor Imperial Preview}} {{1stID|Jendon}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Battle Over Endor Scenario Pack|cardname=Colonel Jendon}} *''[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi: A Visual Archive]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Galactic Empire colonels]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Imperial Navy pilots of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
